Build a deck.gl input node for a Mosaic spec

Source: R/spec.R
mgl_deckgl.Rd

Produces `list(input = "deckgl", id = ..., filterBy = ..., layers = ..., concat = ..., width = ..., height = ...)`. Drop it into a Mosaic spec anywhere an `input = "menu"` would be valid.

Usage

mgl_deckgl(
  id,
  layers,
  concat = NULL,
  filter_by = NULL,
  tools = c("pan", "lasso", "+lasso", "clear", "fit"),
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

id

Required identifier (used for cleanup + lasso source tag).

layers

List of deck.gl layer specs (`@type`, `data`, accessors). Layer `data` is a string referencing a name from `mgl_spec(data = ...)`.

concat

Optional concat config: `list(orient = "hconcat", panes = list(list(x = "umap_1", y = "umap_2"), ...))`. Each pane reuses the same `layers` but with the position accessor swapped to (pane$x, pane$y) — used for the UMAP / PCA dim-pair grid.

filter_by

A Mosaic param reference (character `"$sel"`) or a pre-built Selection. The deck.gl panel subscribes to it and re-renders when its clauses change.

tools

Toolbar buttons. Defaults to `c("pan", "lasso", "+lasso", "clear", "fit")`. `"lasso"` replaces the previous lasso clause, `"+lasso"` unions the new lasso with the previous one, and `"clear"` removes this deck.gl panel's lasso clause.

title

Optional title shown above the canvas.

width, height

CSS dimensions for the panel (number → px).

...

Further options passed verbatim (e.g. `initialViewState`).

Value

A list describing the panel, for use inside [mgl_spec()].

Examples

panel <- mgl_deckgl(
  id = "map", filter_by = "$sel", width = 400, height = 300,
  layers = list(list(`@@type` = "ScatterplotLayer", id = "pts", data = "pts",
                     getPosition = "@@=[x, y]", getRadius = 2,
                     radiusUnits = "pixels")))
panel$input
#> [1] "deckgl"
